name: Add Asana Task
description: Creates a task in Asana from the selected text, using the task's title.

options.label: Personal Access Token
options.description: PAT: In Asana, click your profile photo → Settings → Apps → Manage Developer Apps → Personal Access Tokens → Create new token. Required.

options.label: Workspace Number
options.description: Workspace number: this is the number after /0/ in your Asana URL while browsing that workspace, e.g. app.asana.com/0/123456789/list. Required — tasks need a workspace to be filed in.
